question: Which Article of the Constitution of India mentions about enlargement of the jurisdiction of the Supreme Court?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Article 138**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Article 138** of the Constitution of India mentions the enlargement of the jurisdiction of the Supreme Court.
 
• This article allows the Parliament to confer additional jurisdiction and powers upon the Supreme Court as it deems necessary.
 
• The jurisdiction of the Supreme Court can be expanded in respect to any of the matters enumerated in the Union
